title: Feedback on the afternoon workshop
purpose: Thirteen short questions about how the workshop went for you.

disclosure.purpose: To decide what to keep, cut or change before the workshop runs again.
disclosure.handling: Your answers are read by the organiser only. They are kept in one spreadsheet with no names attached, and deleted once the next workshop has run. Nothing is passed on outside the organising group.
disclosure.contact: Reply to the message that brought you this file.

questions.text: The workshop was a good use of my afternoon.
How did the level match what you already knew?
options: A good mix of familiar and new
Mostly new, and I could follow
Mostly new, and I got lost

questions.text: The hands-on exercise helped me understand the material.
I could use the handout afterwards without the presenter there.
Which parts were most useful to you?
How easy was it to follow from where you sat?
questions.help: Screen, sound, seating. Say what got in the way in the note box.

questions.text: How likely are you to use something from the workshop in the next month?
Would you suggest the workshop to a colleague in the same role?
What one change would improve it most?
What else should the organiser know?
